conversation.text: Anything that would make next week easier?

Things are going well overall! One small thing that would be super helpful is a simple one-page cheat sheet of who to contact for what (like IT, payroll, or SAP access). Last week I spent about an hour just trying to track down who handles SAP password resets, so having a quick list would definitely save time.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee suggested that a contact list for departments like IT and payroll would save time onboarding.
